dst.text: Marek, a vedalken guard, is tested in his loyalty when Pontifex tries to kill Orland and orders Glissa's death, until Bruenna arrives with Neurok wizards.
Marek captures Glissa, but a standoff between Pontifex and Malil lets her escape and find the Kaldra shield.
Glissa emerges in the arm of the Kaldra Champion, slaughtering many vedalken, and Marek later saves her from Pontifex, and Pontifex and Marek kill one another.
